## Relay setting

<!-- LibreWays requires an explicit relay choice before any network request is made — there is no
"no relay configured" or "relay disabled" state. The four selectable modes are direct/no relay,
Tor, HTTP or SOCKS proxy, and self-hosted instance; "direct, no relay" is itself one of the
four, not the absence of a choice. This is relevant to most networking bugs. -->

- Relay mode selected: direct (no relay) / Tor / HTTP or SOCKS proxy / self-hosted instance

  Not tested
